description: Opt-in in Bo1 (`Open Team Sheets`), forced in Bo3 (`Force Open Team Sheets`). The Closed Team Sheet target `gen9championsvgc2026regmc` is a project choice (ADR-003): Areneon declines the opt-in in A2 and A1 never issues it. The engine's open-sheet format `gen9championsvgc2026regmcbo3` (`team_sheets: open`, ADR-027) is an admitted training and evaluation format checked against the target by `checkSheetVariants`: its rule table differs in exactly `openteamsheets`, `forceopenteamsheets` and `bestof`. Whether the in-game open-sheet flow matches the engine's is unverified (format matrix U7). The A2 bot client refuses it (no `confirmready` path).
